patterns.note: A dark, full-width layout with content centered within sections, using generous vertical spacing between major content blocks.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are contrasted with lighter weight body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for categories or sub-sections.
A high-contrast dark theme using a very dark blue background with white and light gray text, accented by a deep blue for interactive elements and abstract glowing visuals.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport. Content sections reveal themselves by sliding or fading up into view as the user scrolls down the page.
Feature sections often utilize a grid of cards, each with an icon or image, a bold title, and a short description, presented against the dark background.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport during scroll. Content sections are designed to animate into view, typically sliding or fading upwards, as they enter the user's viewport, likely using CSS keyframe animations for these scroll-triggered reveals.

A dark background color is used consistently across the site, with white or light gray text for high contrast and readability. Abstract, glowing visual elements are integrated into hero and section backgrounds to enhance the high-tech aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and even smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards, maintaining a modern, clean edge.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with significant vertical padding between major sections and a more balanced density within card grids.

standout: The site's distinctive dark, high-contrast aesthetic, combined with abstract, glowing visual elements, creates a sophisticated and futuristic brand identity that strongly aligns with its focus on advanced AI and superintelligence. It avoids generic dark themes by integrating these visuals deeply into the brand's core concept.
